title: Versioned types, operation identity, durable journal/outbox, native result/ack contract
accepted_note: Claude authored and ran this. Self-testing is not independent acceptance; accepted stays false until a real reviewer inspects it.

evidence_kind.synthetic_local_contracts: units, canonical encoding, journal, results (pure, no network)
evidence_kind.real_offline_sdk: EIP-712 hashing cross-checked against eth_account; journal states reconciled against the real almanak reconciliation predicates via probes/p00_native_workflow_probe.py

requirements.2_eip712_envelope_epoch_runner_bound: identity.py; operation id excludes epoch+runner, envelope binds both
requirements.3_durable_journal_outbox: journal.py; outbox written before network I/O; same-id/different-payload refused
requirements.4_crash_safe_result_handling: results.py; consumer state update + ack in ONE transaction
requirements.7_recovery_after_db_loss: assert_recoverable fails closed; tombstones outlive purged rows

limits: No contract is deployed. controller-interface.md is a design interface only.
Exactly-once is claimed only AT THE CONSUMER, never from a local delivered flag.
No semantic dedup against a runner minting fresh ids for equivalent work.
The hosted result-delivery half is unmeasured under L10.
next_unblocked_phase: P02 - typed controller, Roles enforcement, atomic approval/action/cleanup on the pinned fork
